content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.headline: $WULF held 16.3
queue.body: Below 16.3, the most-traded price of the past six months is gone.

$IPGP needs 80 back.
Below that level, the base is unfinished.
$MUSA needs 524 back before the damage is repaired.

Jobless claims are averaging 203k a week this month.
That's 13.1% below a year ago.
The labor data aren't confirming a growth scare.

$F found buyers at 13.3 for the 3rd time in the past year.
Now 5.4% below 14.1, the busiest price of the past six months.
Most trading happened between 12 and 15.1. Price remains inside that range.

queue.headline: $NX has closed red 3 sessions in a row
queue.body: 17.8 is where the most shares changed hands over the past six months.

queue.headline: The 4-week climb in $SIG has narrowed into today's tight range.
queue.body: Below 100, the move loses its base.
Thrivent opened a roughly $6.00M position in $ARDC. The Form 4 confirms the buy, but the reason isn't in the filing.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.headline: $NX stacks 3 red closes.
queue.body: Price still sits inside the range where most shares traded.

queue.headline: The $WHR setup is finished
queue.body: A close below 38.3 was the exit condition. It closed below.
$SIG has stacked 4 green weeks. Today's tight range leaves the move unresolved.

$COF rejected at the same ceiling for the 3rd time.
Until that ceiling clears, the range holds.

queue.headline: $XBI joins today's most-traded list
queue.body: Trading activity is elevated, but no price level supports a level call.
queue.supply_why: dollar-volume rank #90 ($1.4B a day), inside the top 100 by liquidity

queue.headline: A daily losing streak hasn't broken $DAL's weekly run
queue.body: Below 77.6, the weekly structure loses its footing.
$SGI remains below the 70.3 entry. The setup still hasn't triggered.

$IPGP is trying to rebuild.
Above 80, the recovery has a case.
$PLAB's tight range only matters if 29 holds.
The $TFC CEO opened a new stake. The filing confirms the buy, not his reasoning.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.headline: Growth is firming while inflation stays warm.
queue.body: GDPNow sees 5.1% annual growth this quarter, while median CPI runs at 2.1%. Neither side of the macro argument gets a clean print.

$WFC held 86.7, where six months' heaviest trading sits.
The hold only matters if the next close stays above it.

queue.headline: $UTHR hasn't triggered
queue.body: 518 remains the entry. Until price clears it, the setup stays closed.

queue.headline: Space Tech selling off, -2.7% avg on Thursday
queue.body: $SPIR -6.7% $BKSY -6.3% $ASTS -5.8% $LUNR -5.3% $RKLB -5.2% $RDW -5.1% $FLY -4.8% $TSAT -4.6% Every name on the list is lower.
A $KBDC director opened a new position with a $781K buy. The filing confirms the purchase, but it can't tell us why.

accounts.name: Narrative architect — the story that organises the market, the incentives holding it together, and the fact that changes its meaning

queue.body: $CLH needs a close above 323 before its latest advance counts.
$F held 13.3 again, the third successful test in the past year.

queue.headline: The red run hasn't broken $RBLX's reference point
queue.body: The average price paid during the volume spike is 39.5. It has held for 26 straight sessions.
Today's tight range only matters if $AAP clears 44.7.

queue.headline: $VICR +17.7% on Thursday
queue.body: VICR surged +17.7% on Thursday. VICR has been back above its 50-day average only a few days, after three months on the other side, which is the context the number needs.

queue.body: A $XBP director opened a new position with a roughly $580K buy. The filing confirms the purchase, but can't tell us why he made it.
